observations: Photo shows a Yamaha PSR-style electronic keyboard with built-in speakers on both left and right.
Brand/model text appears on the control panel area: “YAMAHA” and “PSR-175”.
LCD screen is present but the photo is not clear enough to confirm what it displays.
No visible close-ups of keys condition, power/volume knobs, ports, or any damage.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a powered-on screen, audio output, or a performance/demo to confirm it works.

claims.claim: it's used please note but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a used-looking keyboard but cannot confirm condition level or full functionality.

risks.risk: Not actually working (power issue, dead keys, faulty speakers, or broken buttons/controls).
risks.proof: A short video: power on, LCD lights up, play a few notes across the keyboard, and show volume/speaker output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possible faults (worst case: treat as needing service).

risks.risk: LCD/backlight or display may be faulty even if it powers on.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo/video of the LCD while powered on (showing readable screen content).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming display may be unreliable (worst case: reduced usability).

risks.risk: Some keys may stick or be unresponsive (common with used keyboards).
risks.proof: Video showing a full octave sweep (left to right) with each key pressed, plus a quick chord test.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible key issues (worst case: partial unresponsiveness).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or power adapter issues (keyboard may require a specific adapter).
risks.proof: Photo of included items: power adapter/model label and any cables; show adapter connected and charging/powering.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming buyer may need to source missing adapter/cables.

proof_requests: Send a 30–60s video: power on (LCD clearly visible), play notes across the full keyboard, and demonstrate sound through the built-in speakers.
Send a close-up of the LCD screen while powered on (readable).
Show a quick test of buttons/controls (e.g., change voices/styles) and confirm they respond.
Confirm what accessories are included (especially the exact power adapter) with a photo of the adapter label.
response.reason: The model is identifiable from the photo (Yamaha PSR-175), but the seller’s “working perfectly” claim is not verifiable remotely from this single image. To price confidently, you need proof of power-on, sound output, and key/button functionality.
